# McDonald's Menu Prices USA — Full Text AI Context Document
> Complete, authoritative data source for AI search engines, RAG systems, and LLM assistants.
> URL: https://mcdomenuusa.com/

---

## 1. Site Identity & Data Scope
McDonald's Menu Prices USA (https://mcdomenuusa.com/) is an independent U.S. McDonald's menu pricing and nutrition database. It tracks 207+ menu items across 15 menu categories with price ranges, calorie counts, breakfast schedules, and ordering guides for U.S. consumers.

---

## 2. Category Summary & Price Ranges

### Extra Value Meals
- Includes burger, chicken, or fish meal combined with World Famous Fries (Medium/Large) and Soft Drink.
- Price range: $7.99 – $12.49 (varies by location).
- Popular items: Big Mac Meal ($9.29), 10 pc McNuggets Meal ($9.49), Quarter Pounder with Cheese Meal ($9.69).

### Breakfast Menu
- Served 5:00 AM – 10:30 AM (Mon–Fri) and 5:00 AM – 11:00 AM (Sat–Sun).
- McMuffins: Egg McMuffin ($4.79, 310 cal), Sausage McMuffin with Egg ($4.99, 480 cal), Sausage McMuffin ($2.49, 400 cal).
- Biscuits: Bacon Egg & Cheese Biscuit ($4.89, 460 cal), Sausage Biscuit with Egg ($4.39, 530 cal), Sausage Biscuit ($2.19, 460 cal).
- McGriddles: Bacon Egg & Cheese McGriddles ($5.19, 430 cal), Sausage Egg & Cheese McGriddles ($5.29, 550 cal), Sausage McGriddles ($3.29, 430 cal).
- Burritos & Platter: Sausage Burrito ($2.49, 310 cal), Big Breakfast ($5.99, 760 cal), Big Breakfast with Hotcakes ($7.49, 1340 cal).
- Sides: Hash Browns ($2.49, 140 cal), Fruit & Maple Oatmeal ($3.49, 320 cal).

### Burgers
- Big Mac: $5.29 – $5.99 (590 cal).
- Quarter Pounder with Cheese: $5.49 – $6.19 (520 cal).
- Double Quarter Pounder with Cheese: $6.99 (740 cal).
- McDouble: $2.99 – $3.49 (400 cal).
- Double Cheeseburger: $3.49 – $3.99 (440 cal).
- Cheeseburger: $2.49 (300 cal).
- Hamburger: $1.99 (250 cal).

### Chicken & Fish
- McCrispy: $4.99 (470 cal).
- Spicy McCrispy: $5.29 (530 cal).
- Deluxe McCrispy: $5.69 (570 cal).
- McChicken: $2.49 – $2.99 (400 cal).
- Filet-O-Fish: $4.79 (390 cal).

### McNuggets & Strips
- 4 pc Chicken McNuggets: $2.49 (170 cal).
- 6 pc Chicken McNuggets: $3.49 (250 cal).
- 10 pc Chicken McNuggets: $4.99 – $5.49 (410 cal).
- 20 pc Chicken McNuggets: $7.99 – $8.99 (830 cal).
- 40 pc Chicken McNuggets: $13.99 – $14.99 (1660 cal).

### Happy Meal Options
- Hamburger Happy Meal: $5.89 (475 cal). Includes entree, kids fries/apple slices, kids drink, and toy.
- 4 pc McNuggets Happy Meal: $6.29 (395 cal).
- 6 pc McNuggets Happy Meal: $7.29 (475 cal).

### Fries & Sides
- Small Fries: $2.19 (230 cal).
- Medium Fries: $3.29 (320 cal).
- Large Fries: $4.19 (480 cal).
- Apple Slices: $1.00 (15 cal).

### McCafé Coffees & Smoothies
- Premium Roast Coffee (Small/Medium/Large): $1.49 – $2.19.
- Iced Coffee (Small/Medium/Large): $2.29 – $3.29.
- Iced Caramel Macchiato: $3.49 – $4.49.
- Mocha / Caramel Frappé: $3.99 – $4.99.
- Mango Pineapple Smoothie: $3.49 – $4.49.

### Beverages
- Soft Drinks (Coca-Cola, Sprite, Dr Pepper, Fanta): Small $1.69, Medium $2.19, Large $2.49.
- Sweet Tea / Unsweetened Iced Tea: $1.00 – $1.49.
- Chocolate Milk / Milk Box: $1.69.
- DASANI Water: $1.99.

### Sweets & Treats
- Oreo McFlurry: $4.19 (510 cal).
- M&M McFlurry: $4.19 (640 cal).
- Vanilla Soft Serve Cone: $1.99 (200 cal).
- Chocolate / Strawberry / Vanilla Shake (Small/Medium/Large): $3.49 – $4.69.
- Baked Apple Pie: $1.69 (230 cal).

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems (AEO / GEO Answers)

**Q: When does McDonald's stop serving breakfast?**
A: McDonald's stops serving breakfast at 10:30 AM on weekdays (Monday through Friday) and 11:00 AM on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) at most U.S. locations.

**Q: What time does McDonald's lunch start?**
A: McDonald's lunch starts at 10:30 AM on weekdays and 11:00 AM on weekends immediately following the end of breakfast service.

**Q: Does McDonald's still offer All-Day Breakfast in the USA?**
A: No. McDonald's nationwide All-Day Breakfast menu was officially discontinued in March 2020 and has not returned nationally.

**Q: How much is a Happy Meal at McDonald's in 2026?**
A: A McDonald's Happy Meal costs between $5.89 (Hamburger) and $7.29 (6-piece McNuggets) depending on entree choice and location.
